name: Service QC (SA)
help: Query configuration for a specific Windows service
long_help: Retrieves detailed configuration for a service including type, start type, error control, binary path, load order group, dependencies, display name, and service account. Equivalent to 'sc qc'.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target hostname or IP address (empty string for local machine)

arguments.name: servicename
arguments.desc: Service name to query (not display name)
